caption:
New week, new message 📱 Swipe to find your element.

Today is Yin Water over Metal: soft rain and clear air. Good for planning the week and tidying up; skip the big moods.

Your element is the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find it free at the link in bio.

Which one are you? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #zodiacsigns #personalgrowth #fengshui #bazi #chinesemetaphysics #fiveelements #mondaymotivation
day_line: Soft rain on a bare tree. Quiet and clear: good for planning and tidying up, not for big moods.

lines.Yang Wood: Monday goes easier with help. Ask the colleague who's good with spreadsheets.
lines.Yin Wood: Your instincts are sharp this Monday. Trust them, but check the facts first.
lines.Yang Fire: You're on in today's meeting. Prepare one smart point and you'll look like a pro.
lines.Yin Fire: Monday hits hard today. Start with an easy win, then take on the big one.
lines.Yang Earth: Admin Monday. Pay the bill, file the claim, feel like a real adult.
lines.Yin Earth: Keep your eyes open on the commute. A good idea or a good deal turns up today.
lines.Yang Metal: You'll spot the flaw in every plan today. Offer a fix, not just the problem.
lines.Yin Metal: Make Monday fun on purpose: good playlist, nice kopi, a desk snack.
lines.Yang Water: Someone's racing you today, in the queue or the meeting. Let them; pace wins.
lines.Yin Water: A colleague gets you today. Team up on the boring stuff and finish early.
